items.topic: PIN protection: forearm rotation in Henry, Thompson, and lateral radial-head approaches
items.destination_intent: 2026 OITE trauma teaching page; canonical radial surgical approaches/PIN section, resolve at logging
items.teaching_point_placement: Adjacent to supination versus pronation mechanism and approach comparison
items.caption_intent: Exact user-approved Diliberti figure: supination (top) brings PIN crossing proximally; pronation (bottom) moves it distally. The 2.2 and 3.8 cm values are study minima from the radiocapitellar joint, not universal safe zones.
